items.title: John E. Wood Interview, 1986-06-26
items.q: like Irvin Helfer would say, gee, we really want to make sure we go and hear them.

ctx.x: No. I don't think you do. Do you remember the George Williams brass band?

Well, I heard them on the streets a couple of times. They were not there a lot. And whenever they were there, I remember, you know, that people would say, oh, you know, like Irvin Helfer would say, gee, we really want to make sure we go and hear them. That's all. But other than the fact that I know they were there, and in fact they were this set of pictures that I gave you, there's one I have, they were in that, they were in that parade. But I don't have any real recollection of any sort of distinctive sound or…
You don't remember that they were better or worse than the Eureka?
